attempts.sql: SELECT 'auto_ontology/server/' || split_part(file_id, '/', 3) AS folder_path, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%/%.py' GROUP BY 'auto_ontology/server/' || split_part(file_id, '/', 3) HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY total_lines DESC, folder_path ASC;

request:
Within auto_ontology/server/, which immediate subfolders contain more than 1,000 lines of Python in total? Count every .py file anywhere inside the subfolder, including its test files and __init__.py; files directly in auto_ontology/server/ itself belong to no subfolder. Return the subfolder's repository-relative path (e.g. auto_ontology/server/chat) and its total line count.

Requested output columns: folder_path (string), total_lines (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This groups all Python files by their immediate subfolder under the server directory and sums their line counts. It includes test files and package initialization files, while excluding files that sit directly in the server directory. Only subfolders with more than 1,000 total Python lines are returned, ordered from highest to lowest line count.
sql: SELECT 'auto_ontology/server/' || split_part(file_id, '/', 3) AS folder_path, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%/%.py' GROUP BY 'auto_ontology/server/' || split_part(file_id, '/', 3) HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY total_lines DESC, folder_path ASC;
